item.title: Launch BEFORE bench v4 — honest-nulls framing converts the missing proof into brand
item.value: Window (months, not quarters; beat any entrant's 500-star crossing) outweighs waiting for the lift proof. Launch with existence proof (n=2 held-out wins, 0/8→8/8) + 8 published nulls + the over-deliberation tax. v4 becomes the W7-9 follow-up beat; if it lands early+positive promote to headline; if null, publish anyway (R4 decided in advance).

item.title: License: Apache-2.0 + DCO, no CLA (user-confirmed)
item.value: 5 of 6 comparables (incl. every memory competitor + claude-mem) chose Apache-2.0; patent grant matters for mechanism-based moats; AGPL/BSL all-cost-no-benefit for a localhost daemon and off-brand for receipts. Copyright under the author's real name (solo authorship = future flexibility). DCO via Signed-off-by; no USPTO filing pre-traction. Launch as v0.9.0; 1.0 reserved for lift-proof + auto-consult wired + native-compat story.

item.title: Fresh-repo cut, not history rewrite
item.value: agents.json was tracked earlier in the 69-commit history; 15+ tracked bench files embed /Users/imyu paths; commit messages carry private chatter. New public repo from current tree after a PII/secrets sweep (grep imyu|gao|sk-ant|api_key|token); old repo stays private as the real history. filter-repo rewrites are error-prone and still leak via reflog/forks; the history has near-zero archaeology value to outsiders.

item.title: Product shape: plugin primary, MCP-only fallback, clone for contributors — one codebase, three install depths
item.value: Claude Code plugin is the front door (2 commands, ~90% shippable). MCP-only (.mcp.json, mcp-graph.js self-boots the daemon) is the desktop/hookless path — it IS the plugin minus hooks, not a fork. v1 surface trims: classify.sh router removed from default hooks, orch-gate → documented opt-in, loop pacing/budgets de-headlined; keep branch/measure/merge only as the learning loop. Fewer tools = smaller MCP payload = the token-economics brand (payload size was the entire ON-cost story, 1.63x→1.03x).

item.title: Context gate messaging: gated retrieval is LIVE; auto-consult is roadmap (supersedes D2's 'offline module' framing)
item.value: Verified 2026-06-10: daemon.js:24 imports lib/context-gate; gated retrieval path at daemon.js:1202-1215 (?gated=1, abstain-by-default). Only auto-consult-on-task-start remains unwired. Launch copy: 'retrieval is gated and abstains by default' — already the only live regret-calibrated gate in the market; never market it as an autonomous context governor until auto-consult ships.

item.title: Launch mechanics: 48h stacked velocity window + dogfood-the-launch content beat
item.value: GitHub Trending is velocity-relative-to-baseline: stack Show HN (Tue-Thu am PT) + X clip + aggregator DMs + r/ClaudeAI build-story into one 48h window (claude-mem's flywheel). Wedge asset = the null-result receipts post ('we measured when memory HURTS'). Zero telemetry ever at launch (vibe-kanban lesson); awesome-claude-code accepts NO direct PRs (bot-only flow); GitHub Discussions not Discord. The launch itself runs as tasks in our own graph — changelog generated from completed-task summaries is a standing demo.
